knowledge:
- key_parameters: dds=A DESeqDataSet object containing count data and experimental design ;; counts=A matrix of normalized gene counts used for QC and filtering ;; combs=The metadata column name used to define contrasts in degComps ;; contrast=A list of specific contrasts or coefficients to extract in degComps ;; xs=The covariate or grouping variable to plot on the x-axis in gene plots ;; time=The design column used to group samples for pattern detection in degPatterns ;; plot_text=A data frame subset containing gene IDs to label in degVolcano
- alternatives: DESeq2 or edgeR for standard differential expression analysis (which DEGreport wraps and extends); ComplexHeatmap or pheatmap for heatmaps (which can be customized using colors generated by degColors)
- when_to_use: Use when performing RNA-seq differential expression analysis to perform quality control on size factors and covariates, visualize specific gene expression patterns, cluster genes by expression profiles over time or groups, or generate comprehensive HTML reports
- pitfalls: degCheckFactors is not very useful for many samples because the plot becomes crowded ;; Nozzle.R1 is no longer available since Bioconductor 3.16, so users must install it manually to use createReport ;; degPatterns requires a transformed expression matrix (e.g., rlog or vst) rather than raw counts to cluster patterns properly

workflows.name: qc_and_covariate_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform quality control on normalized counts, check size factors, evaluate mean-variance relationships, and analyze covariate effects and correlations.
workflows.stages: 1. Check size factors using degCheckFactors. 2. Run comprehensive QC (p-value distribution, mean-variance) using degQC. 3. Analyze covariate effects on principal components using degCovariates. 4. Test correlation among covariates and metrics using degCorCov.
workflows.code:
degCheckFactors(counts[, 1:6])
degQC(counts, design[["group"]], pvalue = res[["pvalue"]])
resCov <- degCovariates(log2(counts(dds)+0.5),
                        colData(dds))
cor <- degCorCov(colData(dds))
names(cor)

workflows.name: de_downstream_and_reporting
workflows.intent: Extract contrasts, identify significant genes, visualize differential expression results (MA, Volcano, Gene plots), and generate reports.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract multiple contrasts using degComps. 2. Retrieve results tables using deg. 3. Identify significant genes using significants. 4. Plot MA plots using degMA. 5. Plot Volcano plots using degVolcano. 6. Plot individual gene expression using degPlot or degPlotWide. 7. Generate a full report using degResults.
workflows.code:
degs <- degComps(dds, combs = "group",
                 contrast = list("group_Male_vs_Female",
                                 c("group", "Female", "Male")))
names(degs)
deg(degs[[1]])
deg(degs[[1]], "raw", "tibble")
significants(degs[[1]], fc = 0, fdr = 0.05)
significants(degs, fc = 0, fdr = 0.05)
significants(degs, fc = 0, fdr = 0.05, full = TRUE)
degMA(degs[[1]], diff = 2, limit = 3)
degMA(degs[[1]], diff = 2, limit = 3, raw = TRUE)
degMA(degs[[1]], limit = 3, correlation = TRUE)
res[["id"]] <- row.names(res)
show <- as.data.frame(res[1:10, c("log2FoldChange", "padj", "id")])
degVolcano(res[,c("log2FoldChange", "padj")], plot_text = show)
degPlot(dds = dds, res = res, n = 6, xs = "group")
degPlotWide(dds, rownames(dds)[1:5], group="group")
resreport <- degResults(dds = dds, name = "test", org = NULL,
                        do_go = FALSE, group = "group", xs = "group",
                        path_results = NULL)

workflows.name: expression_pattern_clustering
workflows.intent: Detect and cluster genes showing similar expression patterns across experimental groups or time points.
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare transformed expression matrix. 2. Detect expression patterns using degPatterns.
workflows.code:
ma = assay(rlog(dds))[row.names(res)[1:100],]
res <- degPatterns(ma, design, time = "group")
